events.credibility_reason: Main K4-free theorem undisputed, but Corollary 1 (K4-free: word-representable iff perfect) is contradicted by a counterexample in the 2026 preprint.
Known only from a citation; content unread, so nothing it settles can be established.

General Theorem 16 is proved only by a 'sketch' with base cases asserted; its new seven-vertex graph A″ conflicts with the Kitaev–Sun list it cites as complete; one of two claimed corrections is unspecified; no uptake after ~4.5 months. Authors work in the area and no specific error in a key step is identified, so not set aside.

why: The statement asks only about near-triangulations containing K4; the K4-free case is named as already known context, so Glen 2016 (K4-free) and the polyomino/cylinder subclass papers do not settle any restriction of the K4-containing question and are answered variant. The Roy–Hariharasubramanian preprint claims a forbidden-induced-subgraph characterisation of all near-triangulations, which on the statement's wording answers the whole ask; scope is whole, verification unreviewed (no engagement found; finite forbidden graphs are checkable individually but the characterisation itself is not directly checkable). The close call was credibility: the sketch-level induction and the A″ conflict are real doubts but not a specific unanswered error, and the authors are in-field, so doubtful rather than not_credible or knocked_down. Its direction is 'confirmed' in the sense of answering the asked characterisation; its exhibited graphs (Figure 2 counterexample to Glen's corollary, A″) do not bear on the statement as witness or counterexample. The Hauser thesis is year-only 2025, hence after the snapshot, but unread, so scope none.
doubts: Roy–Hariharasubramanian content was read only through a summarising fetch of the HTML; theorem statements, the 'sketch' label and the absence of AI acknowledgements rest on that. Hauser's thesis on chordal near-triangulations may contain a genuine case result on K4-containing graphs, but the record cannot show it. Glen-Kitaev 2015 journal publication unverified, hence unreviewed.
